scope: Current SCI v5 versus H.266/VVC in genuine MP4 on two retained 1080p excerpts. Size and fidelity comparison only.

encodingFfmpeg.configuration: Minimal temporary static build with libvvenc, rawvideo input and MP4 output. No benchmark tools or third-party source added to product dependencies.

tools.decodingFfmpeg: System FFmpeg n9.0.2, native VVC decoder

limitations: Two short excerpts, approximately four seconds each, 1920x1080, 96 source presentation events each.
Both audio tracks are silence; speech and music are not covered.
Quality match means RGB PSNR within 0.5 dB only. SSIM is lower for both selected VVC outputs. Perceived quality is not established as equal.
VVenC Main 10 4:2:0 is compared with SCI eight-bit RGB composition attributes. Results do not characterize every VVC profile or encoder.
VVC IDR refresh is 16 frames for cartoon and 32 frames for fossils. SCI retains its own independent chunk boundaries. Seeking cost is not matched or measured.
Single search encode times are diagnostic only. No speed, startup, buffering, browser support, energy or sustained playback comparison.
Complete file bytes and selected media bodies include audio and format overhead but exclude HTTP headers and decoder assets.
Raw FFmpeg MP4 audio output includes trailing codec padding. Audio audit trims to the declared track presentation duration, then compares exact sample counts and hashes.

rejectedSetup.method: VVenC elementary stream remuxed directly to MP4 with system FFmpeg
rejectedSetup.failure: Raw remuxing discarded the first displayed frame and produced incorrect cadence and duration.
rejectedSetup.resolution: Use a libvvenc-enabled FFmpeg encoder with presentation timestamps passed directly into MP4 muxing. Both selected outputs pass complete frame and timestamp audit.
